tagline.zh: 指针进入吸引半径后,按钮被「吸」向指针按比例偏移,离开即回位;逐帧用 lerp 线性插值逼近目标,触屏与 prefers-reduced-motion 下直出普通 hover。
tagline.en: Inside the attraction radius the button is pulled toward the pointer proportionally and snaps back on exit; each frame lerps toward the target, while touch and prefers-reduced-motion get the plain hover.

origin.zh: 磁吸模式 = 距离判定(dist 阈值)+ lerp 逐帧插值 + rAF 循环,GSAP 官方把「鼠标跟随与磁吸按钮」列为 quickTo(3.10.0+)的示例场景(补研 12§5);Codrops 磁吸教程 URL 因搜索结果污染未能核验,调研明确以 GSAP 文档与标准 lerp 数学为准(补研 12§5 未证实记录)。
origin.en: The magnetic pattern = distance test (a dist radius) + per-frame lerp + an rAF loop; GSAP officially lists "mouse followers and magnetic buttons" as the quickTo (3.10.0+) showcase (12 §5); the Codrops tutorial URL could not be verified due to polluted search results, so the research grounds the pattern on GSAP docs and standard lerp math (12 §5, unverified note).

effect.zh: 吸引强度系数(JS 型,demo 订阅驱动):偏移 = 指针偏移 × radius,即按钮最多走到指针偏移的 45%。默认 0.45 取补研 12§5 实现片段默认值;判定半径常用「盒边界内缩/外扩 25%~50%」的带宽(补研 12§5),该区间为社区常见值。
effect.en: Attraction strength (JS-type, demo-subscribed): offset = pointer offset × radius, so the button travels at most 45% of the pointer's offset. Default 0.45 is the snippet default in 12 §5; the catch band of "inset/expand the box by 25%–50%" is also from 12 §5 — a common community range.

effect.zh: 逐帧插值系数(JS 型):每帧 current += (target − current) × lerp,即 lerp(a,b,n) 的加权逼近。默认 0.15 取补研 12§5 片段默认;该页记载常用区间 0.05~0.2——越大跟手越硬,越小越「稠」。
effect.en: Per-frame lerp factor (JS-type): current += (target − current) × lerp each frame — the lerp(a,b,n) weighted approach. Default 0.15 is the snippet default in 12 §5; that page records 0.05–0.2 as the common band — higher feels snappier, lower feels denser.

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后开关磁吸循环):plain 直出降级后的形态——即 (hover: none) 触屏与 prefers-reduced-motion 用户实际看到的普通按钮(补研 12§5 的降级纪律:大位移缩放/平移是前庭障碍典型触发源,应换成温和溶解或直接关闭磁吸)。
effect.en: JS-type param (the demo subscribes and toggles the magnet loop): plain renders the degraded form — the plain button that (hover: none) touch and prefers-reduced-motion users actually see (12 §5's degradation rule: large displacement scale/pan is a classic vestibular trigger; replace with a gentle fade or switch magnetism off).

note.zh: 实现只依赖 Pointer 事件、rAF 与 getBoundingClientRect,全浏览器可用;prefers-reduced-motion Baseline 自 2020-01 广泛可用(补研 12§5);@media (hover: none) 用于触屏判定。GSAP quickTo 需 GSAP 3.10.0+(补研 12§5);demo 为零依赖手写 lerp 版,无此门槛。
note.en: The implementation needs only pointer events, rAF and getBoundingClientRect — available everywhere; prefers-reduced-motion is Baseline widely available since 2020-01 (12 §5); @media (hover: none) detects touch. GSAP quickTo requires GSAP 3.10.0+ (12 §5); the demo is the dependency-free hand-rolled lerp version with no such floor.

fallback.zh: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 或 (hover: none)(触屏无 hover 语义)时整体关闭磁吸——按钮直出普通 hover/按压态,位移归零;CSS 侧再挂 @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), (hover: none) { translate: none } 双保险(补研 12§5);键盘聚焦永远走 focus-visible 描边,不产生位移。
fallback.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or (hover: none) (touch has no hover semantics), magnetism switches off entirely — the button falls back to plain hover/pressed states with zero displacement; the CSS adds the @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), (hover: none) { translate: none } belt-and-suspenders (12 §5); keyboard focus always uses the focus-visible outline and never moves the button.

use.zh: 营销落地页的主 CTA——磁吸把「可点」预告给指针,GGSAP 官方示例场景即磁吸按钮(补研 12§5)
use.en: Primary CTAs on marketing pages — magnetism advertises clickability; GSAP's own showcase scenario is the magnetic button (12 §5)

use.zh: 桌面端小面积圆形控件(图标按钮、播放键)——吸引半径相对控件大,磁感清晰
use.en: Small round desktop controls (icon buttons, play keys) — the attraction radius dominates the control, so the pull reads clearly

use.zh: 拖拽手柄/悬浮工具球的「预告性位移」,暗示可抓取
use.en: Grab handles / floating tool orbs where the anticipatory pull hints at draggability

avoid.zh: 触屏端——(hover: none) 下没有 hover 语义,磁吸无法成立,直接降级(补研 12§5)
avoid.en: Touch screens — under (hover: none) there is no hover semantics; magnetism cannot exist, degrade directly (12 §5)

avoid.zh: prefers-reduced-motion 用户——大位移平移/缩放是前庭障碍的典型触发源,必须直出普通态(补研 12§5)
avoid.en: prefers-reduced-motion users — large displacement pan/scale is a classic vestibular trigger; the plain state is mandatory (12 §5)

avoid.zh: 高频操作按钮(提交、删除)与密集表单区——预判性位移拖慢瞄准,HIG「高频交互避免加动效」
avoid.en: High-frequency buttons (submit, delete) and dense form areas — the anticipatory pull slows targeting; HIG: avoid motion on frequent interactions

a11y.zh: 磁吸是纯装饰性预告:按钮的可点性不得只靠位移传达(颜色/描边/文字承担语义);触屏与 reduced-motion 用户直出普通 hover,位移为零;键盘走 focus-visible 描边,不跟随指针;demo 实时显示 (hover: none) 与 prefers-reduced-motion 的检测结果,降级路径可见可验证。
a11y.en: Magnetism is purely decorative anticipation: clickability must never ride on displacement alone (color/outline/label carry the semantics); touch and reduced-motion users get the plain hover with zero displacement; keyboard uses the focus-visible outline and never follows the pointer; the demo shows live (hover: none) and prefers-reduced-motion detection so the degradation is visible and verifiable.

goal.zh: 复刻一颗磁吸按钮:指针进入吸引半径后按钮按 radius 比例被吸向指针,离开半径回位;位移逐帧 lerp 平滑并直写 translate;触屏与 prefers-reduced-motion 下自动降级为普通 hover。
goal.en: Replicate a magnetic button: inside the attraction radius the button is pulled toward the pointer proportionally to radius, snapping back on exit; the offset is smoothed per-frame with lerp and written directly to translate; touch and prefers-reduced-motion automatically degrade to plain hover.

acceptance.zh: 距离判定:reach = max(宽, 高)/2 ÷ (1 − radius),半径内目标 = 指针偏移 × radius,半径外目标归零
acceptance.en: Distance test: reach = max(w,h)/2 ÷ (1 − radius); inside it target = pointer offset × radius, outside it target returns to zero

acceptance.zh: 逐帧插值 current += (target − current) × lerp(默认 0.15),配 rAF 循环,位移直写 el.style.translate
acceptance.en: Per-frame lerp current += (target − current) × lerp (default 0.15) in an rAF loop, written straight to el.style.translate

acceptance.zh: 触屏(e.pointerType === touch / (hover: none))与 prefers-reduced-motion 下磁吸整体关闭,直出普通 hover
acceptance.en: Touch (e.pointerType === touch / (hover: none)) and prefers-reduced-motion switch magnetism off entirely, falling back to plain hover

acceptance.zh: CSS 挂 @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), (hover: none) { translate: none } 双保险
acceptance.en: CSS carries the @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), (hover: none) { translate: none } belt-and-suspenders

acceptance.zh: 按钮可键盘聚焦,focus-visible 描边不产生位移;磁吸语义同时由颜色/文字承担
acceptance.en: The button is keyboard-focusable with a focus-visible outline and zero displacement; clickability also rides on color/label
